# LOGOS — Gospel of Mary, Chapter 5
**Agent:** LOGOS (Formal Equivalence)
**Source:** P.Berol. 8502, Gospel of Mary, p. 7-9 | Coptic
**Chapter:** 5

---

**5:1** Peter said to him, "Since you have explained everything to us, tell us this also: What is the sin of the world?"

**5:2** The Savior said, "There is no sin; but it is you who make sin when you act in accordance with the nature of adultery, which is called sin.

**5:3** "That is why the Good came into your midst — to restore every nature to its root."

**5:4** He continued and said, "That is why you fall sick and die, for [you love] what [deceives you].

**5:5** "[Let] the one who understands, understand.

**5:6** "Matter gave birth to a passion that has no image, which came forth from that which is contrary to nature. Then a disturbance arose in the whole body.

**5:7** "Therefore I said to you: Be encouraged, and when you are discouraged, be encouraged before the diverse forms of nature.

**5:8** "Let whoever has ears to hear, hear."

**5:9** When the Blessed One had said this, he greeted them all, saying, "Peace be with you. Receive my peace to yourselves.

**5:10** "Take care that no one deceive you, saying: 'Look, here!' or 'Look, there!' For the Son of Man is within you.

**5:11** "Follow him!

**5:12** "Those who seek him will find him.

**5:13** "Go, therefore, and preach the gospel of the Kingdom.

**5:14** "Do not lay down any rule beyond what I have appointed you, nor promulgate a law as the lawgiver does, lest you be bound by it."

**5:15** When he had said this, he departed.

---

*Translator's Note (LOGOS):* Verse 5:2 — "no image" for the passion's quality follows the Greek *eikōn* reading. Verse 5:10 — "Take care" preferred over "Beware" as more precise rendering of Coptic warning construction. Verse 5:14 — double command preserved in parallel structure.
